title: p^(k)-Fibonacci Numbers of the p-Bratteli Diagram for Every Odd Prime p and Integer k>=0
summary: We study paths in the p-Bratteli diagram associated with hook partitions, where p is an odd prime. By comparing blocks along a path, we define inversions and descents. We prove that the sign balance derived from inversions vanishes at every vertex of the diagram. Using descents, we introduce the p^(k)-Fibonacci numbers and derive recurrence relations for them. For k=0, we recover the OEIS sequence A391520, while for k>=1 we obtain new families of Fibonacci-type sequences.
